intent.outcome: Create a truth-guarded live-action Founder Control Room video that makes people curious about what the project actually does and could help with once fully launched.
intent.truthBoundary: Show current verified architecture and implementation without claiming the product is fully launched or that future outcomes have already occurred.

direction.coreVisualLanguage: real founder work, real screens, real evidence checks, restrained captions

opening.visual: A founder working alone at a laptop. A screen appears to say DONE. The founder stops instead of celebrating, then checks the browser, commit, and evidence.
opening.voiceover: AI is getting very good at doing things. I am interested in whether it knows what actually happened.

middle.visual: Fast live-action cuts of browser testing, code, project screens, a phone, infrastructure checks, and the founder comparing evidence before accepting a result.
middle.voiceover: I am building Founder Control Room so every system works toward one founder intent, and every claim has to survive the evidence.
captions: BUILD · FIX · LAUNCH · GROW · DECIDE · OPERATE · PROVE

truthDisclosure.visual: Hold briefly on the founder and the evidence screen instead of a product victory montage.
truthDisclosure.caption: NOT FULLY LAUNCHED YET.

closing.visual: Founder closes one evidence check, looks back to the work, then the Founder Control Room name appears over restrained live-action footage.
closing.voiceover: But if you want to understand where I think founder software is going, look closer.
closing.caption: Founder Control Room · AI that knows what it can prove.

rules: Do not claim Founder Control Room is fully launched.
Do not claim a render, publication, customer outcome, or external action before outcome evidence exists.
Do not turn continuity evidence into action or publish authority.
Keep future usefulness framed as design intent or future capability, not present outcome.

publicClaims.claim: Founder Control Room has mission-bound media continuity and proof-cookie contracts in the repository.
Founder Control Room is being built so internal capabilities work toward one founder intent and claims are evidence-bound.
Once fully launched, the system could help founders coordinate Build, Fix, Launch, Grow, Decide, Operate, and Prove under one intent.
This video has been rendered, published, or produced a customer outcome.
